mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id, (select h.full_name from hls_lease_item h where h.lease_item_id = pi.lease_item_id)full_name, P.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER, ( SELECT s.ALLOCATION_ID FROM sys_user_allocation s, fnd_employee_assigns f WHERE s.user_id = p.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER and s.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = f.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID and f.PRIMARY_POSITION_FLAG = 'Y' ) ALLOCATION_ID, ( SELECT date_add(min(q.lease_start_Date), INTERVAL -1 MONTH) FROM prj_quotation q, con_contract t WHERE q.quotation_id = t.quotation_id AND t.project_id = p.project_id AND t.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND t.contract_status = 'INCEPT' ) lease_start_date FROM prj_project_lease_item pi, prj_project p WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lease_asset_ln l WHERE l.lease_item_id = pi.lease_item_id AND to_char(l.EVALUATION_DATE, 'yyyy') = to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy') ) AND p.project_id = pi.project_id AND p.contract_status = 'SIGN' AND p.data_class = 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND p.data_type = 'NORMAL' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM con_contract tt WHERE tt.project_id = p.project_id ) GROUP BY p.project_id

SELECT p.project_id, P.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER, ( SELECT s.ALLOCATION_ID FROM sys_user_allocation s WHERE s.user_id = p.HOST_PROJECT_MANAGER ) ALLOCATION_ID, ( SELECT date_add(min(q.lease_start_Date), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) FROM prj_quotation q, con_contract t WHERE q.quotation_id = t.quotation_id AND t.project_id = p.project_id AND t.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND t.contract_status = 'INCEPT' ) lease_start_date FROM prj_project_chance_mp pi, prj_project p WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lease_asset_ln l WHERE l.lease_item_id = pi.lease_item_id AND to_char(l.EVALUATION_DATE, 'yyyy') = to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy') ) AND p.project_id = pi.project_id AND p.contract_status = 'SIGN' AND p.data_class = 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND p.data_type = 'NORMAL' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM con_contract tt WHERE tt.project_id = p.project_id ) GROUP BY p.project_id

SELECT (select h.excel_id from hls_web_excel h where h.enabled_flag = 'Y' and h.excel_type = 'LEASE_RENTAL_REPORT') as excel_id, (SELECT max(hr.result_id) FROM hls_web_excel_calc_result hr ,hls_web_excel hwe where hr.source_document_id = hli.lease_item_id and hwe.excel_id = hr.excel_id and hr.source_document_category = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_RENTAL') as result_id, /* (SELECT nvl(sum(hlid.net_asset_value),0) FROM hls_lease_item_detail hlid where hlid.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id ) net_asset_value_total,*/ ( SELECT nvl( SUM( hlil.QUANTITY * hlil.PRICE ), 0 ) FROM hls_lease_item_list hlil WHERE hlil.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id ) AS net_asset_value_total, (select hbt.description from hls_business_type hbt where hbt.document_category= 'REGULATORY_ASSET_CLASS' and hbt.business_type = hli.asset_types) asset_types_n, (select hdt.description from hls_document_type hdt where hdt.document_category = 'REGULATORY_ASSET_CLASS' and hdt.business_type = hli.asset_types and hdt.document_type = hli.asset_types_sub) asset_types_sub_n, (select hbt.description from hls_business_type hbt where hbt.document_category = 'REGULATORY_ASSET_CLASS' and hbt.business_type = hli.regulatory_asset_class) regulatory_asset_class_n,
(select hdt.description from hls_document_type hdt where hdt.document_category = 'REGULATORY_ASSET_CLASS' and hdt.business_type = hli.regulatory_asset_class and hdt.document_type = hli.regulatory_asset_class_sub) regulatory_asset_class_sub_n,
(SELECT FC.CURRENCY_NAME FROM FND_CURRENCY FC WHERE FC.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' and FC.CURRENCY_CODE = hli.CURRENCY) currency_n, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = hli.if_tangible_movable) if_tangible_movable_n, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = hli.if_obtain_deduction) if_obtain_deduction_n, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'ASSET_STATUS' and scv.value = hli.asset_status) asset_status_n,
(select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'LEASE.FAIR_VALUE_RECOGNITION' and scv.value = hli.fair_value_recognition) fair_value_recognition_n,
(select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = hli.if_registered_ownership) if_registered_ownership_n, (SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = hli.vender_id) vender_id_n, (select scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'CURRENT_OWNERSHIP_REGISTRATION' and scv.value = hli.ownership_register_status) ownership_register_status_n, (select scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = hli.if_since_the_mortgage) if_since_the_mortgage_n, (select scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = hli.if_require_insurance) if_require_insurance_n,
(select scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'PLEDGE_STATE' and scv.value = hli.pledge_state) pledge_state_n, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'HLS.VALUATION_METHOD' and code_value = hli.VALUATION_METHOD) VALUATION_METHOD_N, hli.* FROM hls_lease_item hli
1 = 1
and hli.lease_item_code = #{leaseItemCode}
and hli.lease_item_id = #{leaseItemId}
